title: Pending tools — summary
description: Schema of datasets/pending-tools/index.json. Counts only: this dataset never contains tool names, identifiers, URLs, prices, free-tier figures or commercial-use conclusions. License: CC BY-SA 4.0 — attribution required: AMPM-AIOPS 問問貓 (ampm-aiops.com)

published_rows.description: Rows in data/ai_tools_2026.json when the summary was built.

seed_list_size.description: Identifiers on the maintainers' seed list.

already_published.description: Seed-list tools already in the published dataset.

pending_total.description: seed_list_size minus already_published (after merging same identifier or name).

latest_check_on_record.description: Newest check date among the pending tools (YYYY-MM-DD).

status_counts.description: Pending tools per status: pending-search, pending-verification, incomplete-data, duplicate, inactive, renamed-or-merged.

gap_category_counts.description: Pending tools per gap category; `null` = our records do not say which category applies.

reason_counts.description: Pending tools per neutral reason sentence (zh-Hant).

with_confirmed_homepage.description: Pending tools whose official domain is confirmed.

open_source_review.description: Counts from a one-off check for open-source signals among the pending tools (null = not checked). Signals: repository-open-source-license, repository-license-conditional-or-unmarked, no-matching-repository-link, homepage-unreadable, no-homepage-on-record. Repository roles: product-itself, companion-only, hosted-service-of-open-core, undetermined.
